liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Here Comes Sunshine** (2 reviews): Reviewer considers this the best version of Here Comes Sunshine; Reviewer calls the jam one of the top five in Dead history [11][16]
- **Candyman** (1 review): Reviewer highlights Candyman, Dire Wolf, Row Jimmy, and Bobby McGee [17]
- **Weather Report Suite** (1 review): Reviewer considers this the best version of Weather Report Suite [11]
- **Nobody's Fault But Mine** (1 review): Reviewer considers this the best version of Nobody's Fault But Mine [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-12-19.126124.mtx.dusborne.droncit.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 36 songs; 229 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd73-12-19.aud.clugston.8602.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 28 songs; 216 min; rated 4.5/5 by 10 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording quality is not great but is certainly listenable [14]
- **gd1973-12-19.178707.sbd.patched.flegel.flac1644**: soundboard; 25 songs; 226 min [3]
- **gd1973-12-19.107984.sbd.dan.patch-97361.flac16**: soundboard; 26 songs; 207 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [4]
- **gd73-12-19.sbd.finney.outtakes.197.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 73 min; rated 4.73/5 by 11 [7]

## Around the show

- Reviewer added leftovers to complete the show using Dick's Picks file [9]
- Includes bass solo and opening speech missing from Dick's Picks 1 [12]
- Horns were lost when the band hit the south, missing Sugar Shack [18]
- Dick's Picks 1 shows the band at their late 1973 jazziest best [10]
- Dick's Picks 1 is the choice for a great-sounding second set [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-12-19.126124.mtx.dusborne.droncit.flac16**: source: Matrix from sources: soundboard: 97361; and Dan McDonald's audience tape (new flat transfer) [1]. Also: Transferred using Nakamichi BX-1 with Diamond Cut Forensics 8 equalization [1]
- **gd73-12-19.aud.clugston.8602.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Dan McDonald; source: Audience Recording [2]. Also: Stealth audience recording from the taker's own tape, avoiding roadies and cops; Seeded to etree by Scott Clugston from MAC to PCM to Cassette [2][12]
- **gd1973-12-19.178707.sbd.patched.flegel.flac1644**: source: Patched soundboard by Brian Flegel [3]. Also: Brian Flegel patched Charlie Miller master and Clugston audience sources; Used Roxio Sound Editor and WavePad for speed and pitch matching [3]
- **gd1973-12-19.107984.sbd.dan.patch-97361.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; Dan; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [4]. Also: Soundboard recorded on Sony EMC-22 mic to cheap mono cassette [4]
- **gd73-12-19.sbd.finney.outtakes.197.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [7]. Also: Reviewer upgraded a cassette copy taped off the GDH radio broadcast [13]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Dave's Picks Vol. 58: Curtis Hixon Hall, Tampa, FL 12/18/73](https://store.dead.net/products/daves-picks-vol-58-curtis-hixon-hall-tampa-fl-12-18-73) [22]
- Poster by Bob Marks Grateful Dead: [1973-12-19 Curtis Hixon Convention Hall, Tampa, FL, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1973-12-19-curtis-hixon-convention-hall-tampa-fl-usa/) [23]
